name: i20 Sidebar Widgets
author: Biswabhusan

sections.description:
Free, Easily Customizable informative Sidebar Widgets for your WordPress blogs. In these widgets links are no-follow and pointing to the Articles which are Google AdSense friendly. User can read these Articles using 200+ Global Languages. All Articles showing under these Widgets are Family Safe.

After a successful installation you don’t need to do anything, the plugin “i20 Sidebar Widgets” will automatically fit in your theme. Using Settings, you can Set the number of records you want to show or border and height of these Sidebar Widgets. By default the plugin Comes with 100% width. You can use this in page Header, Side bar or inside Paragraphs. Currently we are supporting 28 popular Categories with more than each of 200+ of high quality Articles. Depending upon your niche from plugin settings you can select which Categories Articles you need to show in Sidebar.

These Widgets are completely dynamic (fetching DATA from SSD Storage xml feeds). Make Sure in every page refresh for 90% cases these Widgets will show new records to the end-user.

You can display these Sidebar Widgets using Shortcode [i20_Sidebar_Widgets].
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins in the Admin menu
  2. Click on the button Add new
  3. Search for i20 Sidebar Widgets and click ‘Install Now’ or click on the upload link to upload i20-sidebar-widgets.zip
  4. Click on Activate plugin
sections.faq:
How to Disable this Plugin?

Just use standard Plugin overview page in WordPress admin section and deactivate it or rename plugin folder /wp-content/plugins/i20-sidebar-widgets over FTP access.

Will it Slow my Site down?

No, it won’t. It’s only loaded on the pages where Shortcode added.

Can I select all 28 Categories?

Yes, by selecting each checkbox you are saying our algorithm to fetch its related Category xml feed. While selecting multiple feeds for each page refresh randomly 1 category feed will select from the array of xml feeds.

What will happen if I am not selecting any Category?

By not selecting any Category Widgets will fetch general feed.
